sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "seed_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense' CHECK("kind" IN ('expense', 'income')), "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), CHECK ((seed_key IS NULL) <> (name IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wallets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "seed_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), CHECK ((seed_key IS NULL) <> (name IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" > 0), "wallet_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("frequency" IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly')), "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" > 0), "wallet_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "recurring_expense_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES recurring_expenses (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "occurrence_date" TEXT NULL, "transfer_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES transfers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "direction" TEXT NULL CHECK("direction" IN ('out', 'in')), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual' CHECK("source" IN ('manual', 'sms', 'recurring')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("recurring_expense_id", "occurrence_date"), CHECK ((transfer_id IS NULL) = (category_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((transfer_id IS NULL) = (direction IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("limit_minor" > 0), "period" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("period" IN ('weekly', 'monthly')), "last_alerted_period_start" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sms_imports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sms_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sender" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('expense', 'income')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" > 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant" TEXT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "card_last4" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('added', 'pending', 'ignored', 'cancelled')), "expense_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES expenses (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_categories" ("merchant_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("merchant_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trusted_senders" ("sender" TEXT NOT NULL, "trusted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("trusted" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("sender"));
CREATE INDEX idx_expenses_category_date ON expenses (category_id, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_expenses_wallet_date ON expenses (wallet_id, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_recurring_active_due ON recurring_expenses (is_active, next_due_date)
